The '''Fen of the First''' was the name given to a small lake on the eastern edge of the [[Malignant Bog]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. It was named for [[the First]], an enormous [[yozusk]] that inhabited the wetland during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
